title: All are Worth Words: A ViT Backbone for Diffusion Models
layout_note: A single vertical stack drawn to column width: input tokens, Embedding Layer, embedded tokens, five Transformer Blocks, Linear, output patches, Rearrange to 3xHxW, Conv3x3, Predicted noise. Long skips are nested elbow loops on the stack's right side. A vertical dashed grey rule separates a narrow right column holding the symbol legend (top) and the Transformer Block internals (middle); the noisy input x_t sits at the bottom right.
grouping: The input row (t, c and image patches) is enclosed in a dashed rounded rectangle captioned 'All as words'. The noisy image x_t at the lower right is shown split into a 3 x 3 tile grid with one arrow into the input row. The right column, behind the dashed rule, holds the legend and a Transformer Block detail drawn as a tall rounded peach container (the same tint as the overview blocks) holding Norm, Multi-Head Attention, Norm, MLP, with Embeddings below it. Colour families by layer type: peach = Transformer Block, cyan = Linear, Conv3x3 and MLP, blue = embeddings, pink = Norm, green = attention, white = Rearrange.
shapes_depth: Flat wide rounded rectangles with thin dark outlines and no shadows; labels in a Times-like serif. Embedded tokens are small rounded tiles tinted by source (grey for t, yellow for c, blue for patches) with a purple index tag (0 ... L) overlapping each tile's right edge; ellipses mark omitted tokens. Image patches and output patches are tiny photo and noise thumbnails, and the prediction is a large noise square at the top. Long skips are thick black elbow lines that enter circled-C glyphs between blocks; ordinary arrows are thin with small heads.
proposed_highlight: The two ideas the figure carries are drawn as distinct marks: time and condition appear as ordinary tokens in the same row as the image patches, inside a dashed frame captioned 'All as words', and the long skip connections are the heaviest lines in the figure, labelled 'Long skip connection' and merged through a circled-C glyph that the legend defines as Concatenate + Linear.
lesson: Each input's tint (grey time, yellow condition, blue patches) continues from its input tile into a matching segment of the shared Embedding Layer bar and onto its embedded token, so which slots belong to which input can be traced without labels.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2209.12152); venue CVPR as recorded in refs.json (venue_source arxiv-journal-ref). Two short arrows leave the top Transformer Block above the t and c positions and end without a target, showing those tokens are dropped before the Linear layer.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: One vertical stack: input tokens, Embedding Layer, five peach Transformer Blocks, Linear, output patches, Rearrange, Conv3x3, Predicted noise; a dashed vertical rule sets off a right column with the legend and Transformer Block internals.
insights.data: Inputs t, c and image patches are a row of small squares in a dashed box captioned 'All as words', with the noisy x_t as a 3x3 tiled photo; outputs are noise patches and a noise image; embedded tokens are numbered tiles.
insights.emphasis: The long skip connections are thick black nested elbows on the stack's right, merging at circled-C nodes, which carries the U-Net idea inside a plain ViT.
insights.flow: Bottom to top along the stack; the skips loop from lower blocks up the right side into upper blocks.

arrangement.units: one vertical stack plus a right column (legend and block detail) behind a dashed rule
arrangement.inputs_as: tokens t, c and real noisy image patches in a dashed box; tiled x_t photo at lower right
